items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: in high school I listened to Prince and I guess all the other popular bands that all the other kids were listening too.

ctx.x: Okay. So when you were 16, 17, the popular music of the day, did it — how do I say this — did it affect you? Did it pull you away from jazz?

The popular music? I mean I definitely listened to it, like on the radio, a lot. I didn’t necessarily go out and like buy it a lot. I would say that when I did start getting into more like jazz music, if I went to the record store to buy a CD, it was probably jazz. But in high school I listened to Prince and I guess all the other popular bands that all the other kids were listening too. And as a musician I’m sure certainly it had its, it made those impressions on me and part of that comes out in my music because…
